text: Nden huunde nde Men ɓanngini ɗun, immorde e yamirooje ɗen e haaɗooje ɗen e ñaawooje huunde ko Joomi maaɗa wahayini faade e maaɗa, wata a jogito -ko an yo neɗɗanke- reweteeɗo goo wonndude e Alla, sakko werleɗaa ka jahannama ñalde darngal felaaɗo, wonkii maa kin fele, yimɓe ɓen kadi fele, raɗaaɗo gaayi kala moƴƴere.
